title: Software Developer (DevOps)
description:
Software Developer (DevOps Focus)

Oxford | Hybrid Working£50,000 - £55,000 + Benefits

The Role

As a Software Developer (DevOps Focus), you will play a key role in designing, building, deploying, and maintaining software solutions that underpin critical data-driven platforms and products. Working closely with scientists, data scientists, and operational teams, you will help deliver secure, scalable, and reliable applications, APIs, and data pipelines.

The position combines hands-on software development with cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD, and production support responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

Software Development

  • Develop and maintain Python-based web applications and REST APIs using Django and/or Flask.
  • Deliver new software features from concept through to production deployment.
  • Build and enhance user-facing interfaces using HTML, JavaScript, and Vue.js.
  • Integrate applications with databases, third-party systems, and laboratory technologies.
  • Contribute to code reviews, testing, and best development practices.

Data Engineering & Analytics

  • Design, build, and support ETL/ELT pipelines for processing scientific and operational data.
  • Develop and maintain Python and R analytical workflows.
  • Automate the ingestion of CSV, Excel, third-party, and public datasets.
  • Support analytical and machine learning pipelines used by scientific teams.
  • Create automated reporting and data-processing solutions.

Cloud & DevOps

  • Deploy and support applications on AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
  • Containerise applications using Docker and manage deployment environments.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response processes.
  • Ensure strong security, access control, secrets management, and infrastructure reliability.

Architecture & Quality

  • Support software architecture and database design discussions.
  • Work with MySQL and PostgreSQL databases.
  • Maintain automated testing frameworks and release processes.
  • Produce technical documentation, support materials, and operational runbooks.
  • Troubleshoot issues and continuously improve system performance and reliability.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics, or a related discipline (or equivalent commercial experience).
  • Commercial software development experience, ideally 3-5 years.
  • Strong Python development skills.
  • Experience with Django and/or Flask.
  • Working knowledge of R or R-based analytical pipelines.
  • Experience deploying and supporting applications in AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong understanding of Git, Linux/Unix, Docker, and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience working with MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL, JSON, and XML.
  • Proven experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT data pipelines.
  • Knowledge of automated testing, software security, and release management.
  • Front-end development experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What's on Offer?

  • Salary of £50,000 - £55,000.
  • Opportunity to work on innovative technology driving advances in healthcare and life sciences.
  • Modern cloud-native technology stack.
  • The chance to contribute to projects with genuine real-world scientific impact.
